title: Mixed-cup FieldNormalization
statement: In the setting and coordinates of [def-sf-mixed-cup-field-coordinates], [def-sf-mixed-cup-field-operations], [def-sf-mixed-cup-coefficient-data], select the common-stage construction datum at the base finite coefficient field. Its rational coefficient-stage data, coefficient transitions and common-stage inclusions are those recorded by [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. For each finite-field inclusion define the operation comparison by the rational operation bridges, the fixed identifications of the recorded stage transitions, and the recorded SixFunctorCoefficientComparison supportAdjunction.left or directAdjunction.right. For passage to the common-stage category use the corresponding recorded commonStageComparison and the source bridge. A family of compact and ordinary cohomology comparisons is field-normalized if on every input each elementary field-inclusion or closure component equals that operation map after applying the recorded point fibre and composing with the fixed point scalar map. The two support choices are imposed separately; identities or cup-square compatibility alone do not define this normalization. The recorded construction data used here is that of [def-sf-operation-stages].
